security.title: No SPF record
security.detail: scribb.xyz does not say which servers may send its email, so signup, verification and password-reset emails are more likely to land in spam or be rejected.
security.fix: Add one TXT record to the domain listing your email provider, for example v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all (use your provider's value).

security.title: Domain has no MX record
security.detail: scribb.xyz cannot receive email, so replies to your signup and support emails bounce.
security.fix: Add MX records for your email provider, or send from an address on a domain that receives mail.

Your consent and a factual, attributable quote.

Your consent and a factual, attributable quote.

tactics.title: Infographics
tactics.brief: A visual summary of https://www.scribb.xyz/, one panel per section: "What you can make"; "How it works"; "Explore".
tactics.reader_benefit: Readers grasp the page's sections at a glance; other writers can reuse it with credit.
prerequisites: Rights to every figure, logo and screenshot used.
A source for every number shown.
A text alternative that says the same thing.
missing: A rights and accuracy review of the page's content.
tactics.measurement: Count new referring pages to the target page 90 days after it ships, from your own analytics or a link export. No rank change is promised.

tactics.title: Article to video
tactics.brief: A short explainer video from https://www.scribb.xyz/, one scene per section: "What you can make"; "How it works"; "Explore".
tactics.reader_benefit: Readers who prefer watching get the same explanation, with a link back to the page.
prerequisites: Permission for anything shown or said.
An accuracy review of the script against the page.
Evidence your audience watches video.
missing: Whether your audience watches video, and a production budget.
tactics.measurement: Views, and visits from the video to the page, 90 days after publishing. No rank change is promised.

tactics.title: Link exchanges
tactics.reader_benefit: Link only where a page genuinely helps the reader, for its own editorial reason.
tactics.policy: Excessive or reciprocal and three-way exchanges, automated link creation and links bought to rank are link spam under Google's policy. Paid placements must be marked rel="sponsored".
